sources.snippet: To address these challenges, this paper proposes DeepVision, a hybrid deep learning framework for detecting deepfake images and videos. The proposed approach integrates EfficientNet-B0 with a Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16) architecture to capture both local texture features and global contextual information effectively.

sources.title: Hybrid Vision Transformer (ViT Hybrid) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the configuration class to store the configuration of a ViTHybridModel. It is used to instantiate a ViT Hybrid model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the ViT Hybrid google/vit-hybrid-base-bit-384 architecture.
